name: Journal Entry 1
description: A grimy desk with a ledger half turned toward you. It hums with a low, sorrowful energy.
short_description: A dusty administrative room with a ledger.

special_commands.inspect_ledger: You brush your fingers over the pages and feel the weight of names lost and debts owed.
special_commands.write_entry: You add your own sorrow into the ledger, and the ink feels colder than it should.

name: Receipt Stacks
description: Shelves of receipts tower around you, each one a small claim on something lost.
short_description: A corridor of ledger shelves and chalkboard calculations.

special_commands.wait_in_line: The queue stretches into a fog of names. Time feels like a commodity here.
special_commands.ask_clerk: The clerk glances up and asks for a slip of paper with your name on it.

name: Approval Booth
description: A narrow booth lined with stamped forms and the scent of ink. A solemn clerk sits behind a glass partition.
short_description: A clerical booth where permitted losses are approved.

special_commands.present_ticket: You slide the ticket under the glass. Frank examines it, his hand hovering near a stack of stamps.
special_commands.request_appeal: You ask if there is any way to appeal a denial. The clerks expression tightens.

name: Supplementary Records
description: A slow-moving stack of supplementary forms and forgotten annotations.
short_description: A dusty annex with lost notes and discarded claims.

special_commands.search_forms: You search the supplemental pile for anything useful, but the handwriting seems to vanish as you look away.
special_commands.ask_goblin: The goblin chortles and offers to bind your documents together if you pay in chaos.

name: Ledger Vault
description: A vault of ledgers sealed with wax and grief. The air tastes of forgotten promises.
short_description: A quiet vault containing the final Loss Ledger.

special_commands.seal_ledger: You set the seal on the ledger. A finality settles, and the room seems to exhale.
special_commands.review_entries: You review the entries. Each loss is a story, and each story weighs heavier than the last.

name: Lost Ledger Alley
description: An alley lined with overturned ledgers, each one jittering as if it wants to be rewritten.
short_description: A tangled alley of lost ledgers.

special_commands.rewrite_entry: You take an overturned ledger and attempt to rewrite one of the losses, feeling the paper resist.
special_commands.collect_ink: You dip your pen into the ink and feel the words you write gather weight.
